metadata.title: A Chern-Weil theory for Lie groupoids with Cartan connections
metadata.abstract: We extend Chern-Weil theory to Lie groupoids carrying a Cartan connection. For a principal $(\Sigma, \omega)$-bundle $(P, {\theta})$ over $X$ we construct a map of differential graded algebras from an $\omega$-basic subcomplex of the Weil algebra of the Lie algebroid of $\Sigma$ to $\Omega^\bullet(X)$, whose map in cohomology does not depend on $\theta$. It recovers the classical Chern-Weil map for Lie groups, the Cartan model for action groupoids, and the characteristic classes of Cartan geometries for gauge groupoids.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 将 Chern–Weil 理论推广到带 Cartan 联络的 Lie 群胚及其主丛。
techniques: Lie 代数胚 Weil 代数
analysis.breakthrough: 构造到底空间微分形式的 DGA 映射，其上同调映射不依赖主丛联络 θ，并统一经典 Lie 群、作用群胚和 Cartan 几何情形。
analysis.limitations: 环境中的 Cartan 联络 ω 属于结构假设；对 θ 的独立性不等于对任意群胚或任意结构选择都自动成立。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 在群胚语言中统一多种特征类构造。
